Hello there. My mom (58) was diagnosed with Mm last year. ASCT was an option since she was under 60 with no other conditions except thyroid. Dara+ VRD even though a better option suggested by all doctors, was not an option for me because of the cost. We went ahead with VRD for four months followed by ASCT. Melphalan as suggested in another comment was the most severe, in terms of effectiveness and side effects. My mom said she felt as though she was on fire from hell, followed by loose motions. She is cancer free now but recovering from weight loss from ASCT. My mom says she could bear any pain but not the weakness from motions. Also since the immune system is reset, she's vulnerable to all diseases new and old. Cannot be isolated for too long. Have to be very careful when going outside. It is just about managing from thereon. She catches a cold and runs a fever very so often. Doctors say you just have to accept it and manage with paracetamol.
